reason: UNMEASURED — the verdict corpus carries vendor alert *evidence* (eventName, mfaAuthenticated, sourceIPAddress), not the enriched event the aggregator reads. Every weak signal it scores is produced by fusion at evaluate time — the first-seen novelty booleans, the item 1.6 ip_class, the baseline deviation scores, the IdP risk verdict — and none of them exists in a static corpus. All 36 malicious and 36 benign items scored 0.0, so there is no distribution to pick a threshold from and the shipped value is the module default.
return_to_measured: A corpus of events replayed through fusion's enrichment — first-seen, baselines and ip_class — so the signals exist to be counted. The replay harness under services/fusion/tests can produce one; re-run scripts/calibrate_weak_signals.py.
